title: The Lob Shot Soft And High (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, when you need to go up and stop
The lob shot is the answer, soft and high it drops
Sixty degree wedge, full commit

[Verse 1]
Sixty degree lob wedge, open the face wide
Open the stance forty five degrees, ride
Ball position off the lead heel, way forward
Weight fifty fifty, dont lean toward

[Pre-Chorus]
Full swing, son, dont quit
The ball pops up almost vertical with it
Lands soft, no roll, stops on the dime
Use it when you have to clear and chime

[Chorus]
The lob shot soft and high, son
Open face, open stance, full commit run
Up and over the trouble, lands like a feather
Stops on a dime, the lob shot tether

[Verse 2]
Use it over a bunker to a tight pin
Use it from rough beside the green to win
Need clean lie though, dont try from the bare
Bladed lobs into trouble, beware

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the lob is a specialty shot
Practice it fifty times before you use it a lot
Full swing always, never half hearted
Commit or skip, son, dont leave it departed

[Chorus]
The lob shot soft and high, son
Open face, open stance, full commit run
Up and over the trouble, lands like a feather
Stops on a dime, the lob shot tether

[Outro]
Sixty wedge, open face, open stance
Full commit, no half stance
Up and over, soft landing
Thats my boy, sand standing
